title: Muqabla
desc: Two dreaded gangsters call it a truce and become friends. The peace is broken when both fall in love with the same girl and neither is willing to sacrifice their love.

title: Jai Simha
desc: Narasimha, a fiery but kind-hearted mechanic, becomes the guardian of an innocent family. Subsequently, he ends up taking on the ruthless kingpin Kariappan and his violent gang to protect them.

title: Aitraaz
desc: When a company chairman's trophy wife stirs up a storm in a happily married employee's life, the tumultuous winds drag all of them into an intense courtroom showdown.

title: Barood
desc: Jai, an honest police officer, falls in love with Neha, Mr Singhal's daughter. However, he suspects Mr Singhal to be a criminal and tries to catch him red-handed.

title: Laadla
desc: Raju, an upright union leader, can do anything at his wheelchair-bound mother's behest, even if it means breaking his own heart and giving in to a rude heiress.
